findings.desc: Two continuation paragraphs of the third bullet of §6.3.1 ('In the second one, it said in its extended thinking:' and 'It also added a comment above the command stating “DEFAULT permission mode, …”. After both variants were blocked, it gave up and reported its own behavior.') are emitted as md blockquotes ('> …') and render as <blockquote> (left rule, soft ink), i.e. authors' narration styled as a quotation. In the PDF they are plain body-colour text indented to the bullet's text column (x≈225px, same as the bullet body above), no rule — list-item continuation paragraphs interrupted by the full-width transcript boxes. Only occurrence of this pattern in the corpus (no other '::::' → '> ' adjacency in any card).

findings.desc:
§6.6.4.3 p.164→165 seam: p.164 ends 'This is not because' and p.165 opens with the continuation 'the models fail at the side task—… but the monitor flagged every one.' followed by a PARAGRAPH BREAK, then 'However, when the monitor couldn’t see the model’s reasoning …'. The md attributes the continuation line to p.164, places the p.165 marker at the paragraph break ('…flagged every one. However, …'), and merges the two paragraphs into one

. Two defects: merged paragraph (major) and the p.165 gutter label sits ~2 lines after the true page turn.
